headline: Colombia's DIAN Amends Exogenous Tax Information Filing Requirements
summary: Colombia's national tax authority DIAN updated guidelines and formats for reporting exogenous tax information, setting new gradual compliance schedules for companies.
why: Changes to exogenous reporting requirements affect corporate compliance burdens, accounting systems, and audit risks for businesses operating in Colombia.

entities.name: Direccion de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
